entries.name: Frühling Weizen
entries.style: Spring Bavarian Amber Wheat Bier. Known in Germany as "Bernsteinfarben" or Amber-colored, this wheat bier has a more pronounced malt character, and richer color. A pronounced yeast character of spice, nutmeg and clove on top of soft wheat malt.

entries.name: ITALIAN PILS
entries.style: Young dry hopped Pilsner brewed with Spalter Select, Saphir and Perle hops from our favorite family hop farm in Tettnang.

entries.name: Kräusen
entries.style: Helles Märzen. A Helles Lager that was naturally carbonated (Kräusened) with a small addition of fermenting Rauchbier Märzen. Honeyed malts and the faintest whisper of smoke.

entries.name: MAIBOCK
entries.style: Heller Bock brewed to celebrate the arrival of spring and Biergarten season. Rich Heirloom German Barley adds layers of sweet biscuits saturated by a double decoction in the brewhouse. Tettnang-grown Perle hops add their pleasant bitterness and minty aroma. An extended rest in our Keller of almost 6 months rounds everything out.

entries.name: PILSNER
entries.style: Classic German Pilsner brewed with German Pilsner malt, and the finest Tettnang-grown Hallertau Mittelfrüh and Saphir hops.

entries.name: PREMIUM LAGER
entries.style: An all-malt, patiently lagered and full-flavored beer made for everyone.

entries.name: ZWANZE PILS
entries.style: Belgian Pilsner brewed as a homage to Cantillion, and the incredible honor of being selected to host Zwanze Day this year. Sugar Creek French Pilsner malt lends a rustic, farmhouse character that is supported by the use of aged, whole-leaf lambic hops in the boil.
